goal: Calculate US yearly birth totals from 2005 onward, compute the compound annual growth rate (CAGR), and produce an executive Business Action Brief.

plan.description: Query public BigQuery dataset for US yearly birth totals from 2005 onward.
args: SELECT year, SUM(number) AS total FROM `bigquery-public-data.usa_names.usa_1910_2013` WHERE year >= 2005 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

plan.description: Calculate the compound annual growth rate (CAGR) across the retrieved time series.
